look. you can do all sorts of things.

You can do a lot of that on mobile. YOu can keep Wifi turned on only when you're at home. You can disable GPS. YOu can use web pages (through mobile firefox with aforementioned extensions) rather than installing apps. YOu can be weary of what apps have permission to what and limit those on Android 6.0 and up.

You can ditch Windows 10 for Linux even.

You can abandon Google - use duckduckgo, or searx or startapage for search. You can use Zoho for mail, calendar. You can try to keep your docs local rather than use a Docs or Dropbox like service. If you have time and money, you can roll your own email and groupware solution (Zimbra, Next/Own-Cloud, etc..)

But at the end of the day...after all your efforts - you will still be tracked. Tracking pixels, some app on your phone listening to your microphone. Some device you bought at home (samsung tv, xbox kinect, amazon echo) that will be listening.

The best thing you can do? Shop local. Walk away from the internet. Make calls on a landline. read a book. Hangout with flesh and blood people. Minimize your internet usage to absolute minimals.
